flow.title: Where the extension's data goes
flow.desc: One box, your computer, holds the dj-digger desktop app and your browser with the dj-digger extension. App and extension are joined by native messaging, their only channel. The only arrows that leave the box run from the tabs the extension opened for the app to five sites: Hypeddit, ToneDen, Bandcamp, Beatport and SoundCloud. A box for the developer stands outside with no arrow: nothing is sent there.
